function.name: nearest_analog_year
function.description: Find the historical year (2001-2025) whose climate signature most closely matches the current season, based on monsoon onset timing, onset rainfall amount, dry spell length, and mean temperature. Uses NASA POWER daily climate data.

current_season.description: The current season's observed values for the four matching features.

onset_doy.description: Day of year the monsoon onset was observed.

dry_spell_days.description: Longest dry spell so far this year, in days.

mean_t2m_c.description: Mean temperature so far this year, in Celsius.

function.name: backtest_rotation
function.description: Replay a candidate crop rotation plan against real historical NASA SMAP soil moisture and POWER climate data from a specific analog year, and count how many days had adequate soil moisture for that day's crop water demand (using FAO-56 crop coefficients).

analog_year.description: The historical year to replay, from nearest_analog_year()'s result.

rotation_plan.description: The sequence of crops in the candidate rotation.

function.name: cite_check
function.description: Return true only if every numeric claim in a proposed answer maps to a dataset id and source URL. Must be called before any narrated answer containing numbers is shown to the user.
